description: GORG: TECHTRA (TTA) standard triple GEM, Ar:CH4 92:8 at 1 atm, powered by V_drift + V_GEM through the HV divider
notes: Geometry from the setup: 18 mm drift (1 mm slice simulated, true drift field applied), 2.1 mm transfer gaps, 2.1 mm induction gap to the charge-sensitive readout.
Foil names follow the TECHTRA board: GEM3 is the TOP foil (next to the drift, at -V_GEM), GEM1 the bottom one (next to the readout).
HV as in the lab: V_GEM feeds the divider at GEM3_U, V_drift = V_GEM + 500 V (GORG catalog: V_drift - V_gem = 500 V in every run). Drift field = 500 V / 18 mm.

Divider: TECHTRA 'GEM HV Divider Separate Drift cover V1.0' (AGUILA/hardware/high_voltage/gem_divider.py, config techtra_v1): GEM3 R11-R15 5x110k, transfer32 R16-R20 5x200k, GEM2 R21-R25 5x100k (unprinted, fitted to the bench measurements), transfer21 R26-R30 5x200k, GEM1 R31-R34 4x84.5k + R35 102k, induction R36-R40 5x200k; 4.49 MOhm. Unloaded shares (the GEM electrodes draw no current): 12.25 / 22.27 / 11.14 / 22.27 / 9.80 / 22.27 %.
Foils: standard CERN GEM foils: 140 um hex pitch, 50 um kapton, 5 um Cu, double-conical holes 70/50 um.
GORG pressures are absolute psi (14.5 psi = ambient). This config is 1 atm; the gain-curve scans use the measured pressures.
Penning: Garfield's Ar:CH4 parameterisation (Sahin et al. 2010, pressure dependent): r = 0.21 at 1 bar, 0.23 at 4 bar for 8 % CH4.
Gas temperature 20 C (not recorded in the GORG logbook).
